adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/constants.ts`, `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY;`, which in JS evaluates to the last truthy operand (i.e., the **raw encryption key string**), not a boolean. The diff shows this constant being used as a boolean guard (e.g., `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED)` in `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` and branching in `parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`/`refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), so it will silently carry sensitive string data through the codebase. That creates a real risk of accidental leakage if this constant is ever logged/serialized or ends up in a client bundle, and it’s easily fixed by coercing to boolean (e.g., `Boolean(...)`).
